summary: Regression retest for iteration_1 HIGH-priority bug fix: /app/exchange route was missing. Verified the fix — clicking [data-testid=btn-exchange] on AppHome now navigates to /app/exchange and correctly renders the new AppExchange placeholder page (exchange-title 'صرف العملات' + exchange-coming-soon block 'قريباً' with description). [data-testid=exchange-back] navigates back to /app/home successfully and the home page re-renders with home-username visible. All 6 assertions PASS. Fix is verified.
critical_code_review_comments: AppExchange.jsx is clean, minimal, and self-contained. RTL arrow flip (rotate-180 for ar) is handled correctly on exchange-back.
Consider hoisting the L (localization) dictionary into a shared i18n resource file — several pages (AppExchange, AppReceive, AppSend, etc.) each declare their own L map, causing scattered strings.
